# Step 1: compute required workout duration from Simple Note again (safety) and fetch all Spotify library playlists
from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now()
workout_day=now.strftime('%A').lower()  # e.g., thursday

note_content = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=836, access_token=access_token)['content']
import re
pattern = rf"day:\s*{workout_day}\s*\n.*?duration_mins:\s*(\d+)"
m = re.search(pattern, note_content, flags=re.S)
duration_mins = int(m.group(1)) if m else None
required_seconds = duration_mins*60 if duration_mins is not None else None
print('workout_day', workout_day, 'duration_mins', duration_mins, 'required_seconds', required_seconds)

spotify_token = globals().get('sp_login', {}).get('access_token')
print('spotify_token_present', spotify_token is not None)

# fetch all playlists from library (paginated)
playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(page) if page else 0)
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlists', len(playlists))
# show top 10 by song count
playlists_sorted = sorted(playlists, key=lambda p: len(p.get('song_ids',[])), reverse=True)
for p in playlists_sorted[:10]:
    print('playlist_id', p['playlist_id'], 'title', p['title'], 'song_count', len(p.get('song_ids',[])))

# store for later
candidate_playlist_summaries = playlists_sorted

required_seconds=globals().get('required_seconds',None)
print('required_seconds', required_seconds)

# use candidate_playlist_summaries from prior block
candidate_playlist_summaries = globals().get('candidate_playlist_summaries', [])
print('num_candidates', len(candidate_playlist_summaries))

playlist_totals=[]
for p in candidate_playlist_summaries:
    pid=p['playlist_id']
    title=p['title']
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=spotify_token)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    total_dur = sum([s.get('duration',0) for s in songs])
    playlist_totals.append((pid, title, len(songs), total_dur))
    print('playlist', pid, title, 'songs', len(songs), 'total_dur', total_dur)

# sort by total_dur descending just to inspect
playlist_totals_sorted=sorted(playlist_totals, key=lambda x: x[3], reverse=True)
print('totals_sorted')
for row in playlist_totals_sorted:
    print(row)

# pick first playlist in original candidate order with total_dur >= required_seconds
selected=None
for pid,title,ns,total_dur in playlist_totals:
    if total_dur >= required_seconds:
        selected={'playlist_id':pid,'title':title,'songs':ns,'total_duration':total_dur}
        break

print('selected', selected)
